start.choice: Thank you for your protection, friend.

node.text: heheheh. mine rock. rock mine.~ bite wall? grehehe.
Mind the cairns, wayfarer, lest you knock one over.~ Seen a few baboons today. Not one made it further than a stone's throw.

Stones talk sometimes. Just gotta listen real close, and you can hear 'em singing.~ Need something sculpted? Man, boar, fish?~ I sometimes wonder if the stones feel like we do. Carving must hurt then, eh?~ Don't know the name of the rocks around here, but they carve just the same.
Smashed through a wall last week, soaked my clothes. Damn aquifers.~ Overseer said we needed to square away more rock, but my back's been killing me... got any witchwood?
Ain't easy work overseein' a warren like this, wayfarer.~ Make sure not to find yourself on the wrong side of the outrider, and you'll do fine.

Come, wayfarer. My stonesup tools are yours to work.~ Helmets, lights, picks... make certain of the stock you buy now, for a missing piece could prove fatal.~ The rocks here are loose. With my wares, you could be rid of them altogether.~ Ah, to feel the sunlight on your skin, wayfarer. Tell me, is it sweeter than the taste of fresh water?
